advisory.headline: Moderate landslide risk, low flood risk in Wayanad hills
advisory.flood_summary: Flood score 6 (Low). Peak discharge 0.31 m³/s on 2026-11-29, below threshold 1.35 m³/s. Rain total 37.3 mm in 7 days, max daily 8.8 mm.
advisory.landslide_summary: Landslide score 38 (Moderate). Soil saturation 0.97, soil moisture peak 0.44. Relief 0.17, elevation factor 0.5. Rain trigger 0.12, rain peak day 0.09.
immediate_24h_actions: Check that all roof and wall cracks are sealed to prevent water seepage.
Clear debris from the road and drainage channels near the settlement.
Move livestock and stored grain to higher ground away from slope bases.
Secure loose tools, pots, and firewood on stable platforms.
Turn off electric appliances near wet areas and keep generators outdoors.
next_48_72h_actions: Monitor daily rainfall forecasts; if precip_prob >80% stay alert.
Inspect slope faces for new cracks or bulges each morning.
Reinforce retaining walls with sandbags or earthbags if water seeps behind them.
Prepare evacuation route to the nearest safe zone on the main road.
agri_livestock_steps: Move cattle, goats and poultry to the community high‑ground shelter.
Elevate stored rice, millets and spices on pallets above floor level.
Cover fodder stacks with waterproof tarpaulins.
Check that water troughs are clean and positioned away from possible runoff.
evacuation_checklist: Pack emergency kit: water, dry food, medicines, torch, battery.
Carry important documents in a waterproof bag.
Load livestock into sturdy crates and keep them calm.
Take a map and note the nearest safe road or school shelter.
Inform all neighbours of the evacuation plan.
Leave early if road water rises or landslide sounds are heard.
advisory.confidence_note: Based on the provided telemetry and risk scores, confidence is high for the flood outlook and moderate for landslide warnings.
